mapper.insert: insert into sys_salary_scheme_revision (scheme_id, version, change_type, change_reason, snapshot_json, create_by, create_time) values (#{schemeId}, #{version}, #{changeType}, #{changeReason}, #{snapshotJson}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select revision_id, scheme_id, version, change_type, change_reason, snapshot_json, create_by, create_time from sys_salary_scheme_revision where scheme_id = #{schemeId} order by version desc, revision_id desc
